name: Pair spread sensitivity
description: Sensitivity factor for pair-spread trading, clamped to [0,1]. Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. Tag 231 is also in the hard-coded list of sub-tags inherited by legs of a compound portfolio-tracker order (compound mode 5).

example.explanation: Half sensitivity to the pair spread (passed to the scheduler).

name: MOC mode (scheduler-driven close)
description: Turns on scheduler-driven MOC handling. When moc_mode>0 the close-auction size comes from the scheduler's MOC candidates (setSchMocSize) and the OEO strategy does not send its own close-auction order (ConcertStrategy returns NONE; non-step-up MOC orders are blocked). A value above 10 is split: tens digit = moc_maxpart_mode, units digit = moc_mode (e.g. 11 -> maxpart mode 1, moc mode 1).

allowedValues.meaning: Off: the OEO close logic owns the auction order

default: 0; moc_maxpart_mode from AlgoConfig moc_maxpart_mode (per exchange, default 0)

example.explanation: Scheduler-driven MOC with max-participation mode 1 on the close.

interactions.title: moc_mode forced to 0 when there is no close
interactions.explanation: moc_mode() returns 0 when tag 9009 is present with doClose=0, when 9015 inclose=0, when the close is excluded, or for DLP-sourced orders; setDoClose(0) also resets it (restored from the original value when doClose goes back to >0). So 232 has no effect unless the order participates in the close.

interactions.title: OEO stops sending its own MOC
interactions.explanation: With moc_mode>0 ConcertStrategy returns ActionType.NONE for its close action and FlexOrderStream refuses non-STEPUPMOC MOC orders; the close quantity is the scheduler MOC candidate size, zeroed after pre-close end.

interactions.title: Rule file writes 232 from 20 rules (conflict C-15)
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 232 in many rules with values 0/1/11 (e.g. L198/L199 set 0 for VWAP by moc_rate_type, L245 sets 1 for orders starting at/after close, L246/L247 reset to 0, L301 default 1 for non-schedule algos, L306 sets 11 for VWAP/TMX in AU/NZ/TB/PM/SP/KS/TT/HK/MK, L622-L644 set 1 for China/KS/IN). The final value is decided by rule order (conflict C-15); L246 contains the misspelling 'echangeCode' (conflict C-03).

interactions.title: VWAP/TMX in APAC get 232=11 by default
interactions.explanation: If 232 is not set and the order has close participation (tag 15 != 0), VWAP/TMX orders in AU/NZ/TB/PM/SP/KS/TT/HK/MK get 232=11.

interactions.title: SDMA with 312 in SEA/AU: 232 forced to 0
interactions.explanation: For SDMA in SP/IJ/MK/PM/AU with tag 312 present and start before MOC, the rule file sets 232=0.

name: MOO PM (afternoon open) mode
description: Mode for participating in the afternoon (PM) opening auction, with an optional theoretical-open-volume fraction. moopm_mode>0 makes moo_pm_rate_type() default to 1 (3 if the stock has no PM indicative open) when 233 is not combined with 276; mode 4 makes the theo fraction follow the morning moo_theov_fraction. With moopm_mode>0 a FlexOrderStream PM-open path returns early.
default: mode 0; theov fraction from OEO config moo_theov_fraction(exchange) when not given, clamped [0,1]

example.explanation: Join the PM open, using 20% of theoretical open volume.

interactions.title: 233 implies a PM-open rate type
interactions.explanation: If 276 is not set (rate type <= 0) and moopm_mode>0, moo_pm_rate_type() returns 1 (or 3 when the stock has no PM indicative open), enabling PM open participation. Ignored entirely when the stock has no PM open.

name: Cash residual-imbalance aggression
description: Aggression used for residual imbalance in cash (portfolio) trading. Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key cash_res_imb_aggr).

name: I-Would ignores relative limit
description: When >0, I-Would (would-price) liquidity is allowed to ignore the order's relative limit price: the checks in CandidateProcessor and FlexOrderStream treat the would price separately from the relative limit.

allowedValues.meaning: Would orders respect the relative limit
Would orders ignore the relative limit

name: Portfolio PM-tracker limit style
description: Integer style passed to the PortfolioPMTracker constructor (portfolio P&L/price-move tracker). Only meaningful when the portfolio PM tracker mode/reftype strings are set.

name: Inherit sub-parameter tags
description: Comma-separated list of 9012 sub-tag ids that a compound/parent order passes to its child (sub) orders. 'ALL' copies every 9012 tag except those in config exclude_from_inherit_subparam. Overrides the AlgoConfig inherit_subparam_tags list for this order.

example.explanation: Children inherit I-Would price (10), 11, 19, 155 and 284 from the parent.

interactions.title: Compound templates set 237
interactions.explanation: Rule-file COMPOUND templates (T.Rowe preopen L501/L502, STARSLTSC L534 with 237=ALL) set 237 so that parent tags flow into the legs.

name: I-Would price currency
description: Currency (CurrencyType code, e.g. USD) in which the I-Would / would-dark / would-stop / begin prices (tags 10, 207, 33, 39) are expressed; passed to IWouldPrice parsing so the price is converted to the stock currency.

example.explanation: I-Would price in tag 10 is given in USD.

interactions.title: Only matters with an I-Would price
interactions.explanation: 238 only changes the interpretation of would-type prices (tags 10/207/33/39).

name: IEX dark mode
description: Controls use of IEX dark (midpoint) liquidity. First field: units digit = mode, tens digit = would-dark flag. Mode 1: field2 = % of order shares to rest on IEX dark, field3 = max %; mode 3: field2 = trade-filter name used to size IEX dark from filtered IEX volume. Other modes clear the would-dark flag. When >0, IEX is excluded from some generic venue lists and pmid/dark aggressions are routed specially.

example.explanation: Keep 20% (max 40%) of the order resting in IEX dark.

interactions.title: IEX max fraction disallows tag 213
interactions.explanation: When the IEX max fraction (field 3 of mode 1) is >0, CandidateProcessor adds tag 213 to the disallowed tags for the order.

interactions.title: Reset when no IEX dark worker
interactions.explanation: If no IEX dark worker can be set up, ConcertStrategy logs 'no iex dark, resetting tag 239' and sets the mode to 0.

interactions.title: Parser bug: 4th field re-reads field 3
interactions.explanation: When a 4th field is given, iex_would_split is parsed from a[2] (the max-pct field) instead of a[3].

interactions.title: AU default trade filter only when 239 absent
interactions.explanation: Rule L261 sets 317=CP:1 for AU only when both 317 and 239 are unset.

name: IEX check (ping) mode
description: IEX check/ping behaviour. First field m: units digit = iex_check_init (if >0, an initial IEX check order of field2 % of shares is sent; field3 selects the price type), tens digit = iex_check_take (1/5: IEX check before taking; 3: special handling of TAKE aggression in ExchangeMaster).

example.explanation: Initial IEX check with 10% of shares and check IEX before takes.

name: IEX would mode
description: Parsed into _iex_would_mode, but the accessor iex_would_mode() is not called anywhere in this source tree; no observable effect.

name: Free style
description: Integer flag; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key FreeStyle). Meaning not determinable from the engine.

name: Profile deviation aggression
description: Scales the allowed deviation from the volume profile: min/max schedule deviation are multiplied by max(0.01, 1+value). Positive values widen the band, negative narrow it. Max deviation is 0 regardless when impact_profile_mode>0.

example.explanation: Allow 1.5x the configured min/max schedule deviation.

name: Peg size fraction
description: Fraction (clamped 0..1) of workable shares used as the size of a peg candidate.

interactions.title: HK SDMA short sell defaults 244=1
interactions.explanation: Rule L5 sets 244=1 for SDMA short sells in HK when 244 is unset.

name: Work all shares
description: When >0 the workable/must-make size is the whole available quantity rather than the schedule target (CandidateProcessor, DMA strategy, LC worker). In DMAStrategy mode 2 additionally loops over venue allocations until all shares are placed.

allowedValues.meaning: Work all, DMA places every share across venues (retry loop)

interactions.title: DMA family default 245=2
interactions.explanation: Rule L472 sets 245=2 for DMA/SDMA/ICEDMA when unset; but L375 (245=1 when tag 57 is set) fires first, so L472 is dead for those orders (conflict C-12).

interactions.title: SDMA MPO default skipped when 245=2
interactions.explanation: Rule L273 only sets MPO=1 for SDMA when 245 != 2.

name: Post participation rate cap
description: Caps passive (post) shares at value% of the eligible market volume (advltEffNoWould) minus shares already made; also requires minimum traded volume before posting. Divided by the number of split sub-orders when an order is split.

example.explanation: Passive fills limited to 10% of volume.

name: Work participation rate cap
description: Caps total working size at value% of adv1t (effective volume since start, no would); if market volume is too small the size upper bound is frozen at current makes. Divided across split sub-orders.

example.explanation: Never work more than 15% of traded volume.

name: Take order duration
description: Lifetime of take (aggressive) child orders in seconds (stored as ms); used as the end stamp of take work orders in Concert/DMA/NDMA/Take workers.

interactions.title: TT and China default 248=7
interactions.explanation: Rules set 248=7 for TT and C1/C2/CH when not set.

name: Post during pre-open
description: Posting in the pre-open session. Units digit = post_preopen level (values >2 require a limit price, otherwise reduced to 2), tens digit = post_preopen_mode, field 2 = buffer (ms) used by NDMA. Any value >0 disables open-auction participation (doOpen and doPMOpen set to 0). Levels >2 let DMA/DLP post before open; >=2 changes several pre-open checks in FlexOrderStream.

allowedValues.meaning: Pre-open posting at limit (needs limit price)

interactions.title: Pre-open posting cancels open auction participation
interactions.explanation: If post_preopen()>0 the order's doOpen and doPMOpen are set to 0, so any open-auction instruction is dropped.

interactions.title: Level >2 reduced to 2 without limit price
interactions.explanation: post_preopen() lowers values >2 to 2 when the order has no limit price (and no limit-price percent).

interactions.title: DMA family defaults (conflict C-11)
interactions.explanation: Rules default 249=2 for DMA/SDMA (L464) and 249=3 for ICEDMA (L471); L479 forces 249=0 when tag 14=0.

name: Min participation rate (RT)
description: Minimum participation rate in percent on the 'RT' volume basis (advrt, separate from the normal min part level). Validated in checkForError: rejected if >0 but below config minpart_reject_min, or above minpart_reject. Divided across split sub-orders.

interactions.title: Out-of-range RT min rate rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'min part level rt too small' / 'min part level rt > bound' and the order is rejected.

name: Max participation rate (RT)
description: Maximum participation rate in percent on the RT (advrt) basis; ConcertStrategy caps the part-cap using advrtEffNoWould. Rejected if above maxpart_reject or >0 but below maxpart_reject_min. Divided across split sub-orders.

interactions.title: Out-of-range RT max rate rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'max part level rt > bound' or 'too small' and the order is rejected.

name: Target participation rate (RT)
description: Target participation rate in percent on the RT (advrt) basis; used as the RT cap when 251 is not set. Same reject bounds as 250/251. Divided across split sub-orders.

interactions.title: 251 beats 252 as RT cap
interactions.explanation: ConcertStrategy uses maxPartLevelRT and only falls back to targetPartLevelRT when 251 is <=0.

interactions.title: Out-of-range RT target rate rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError rejects when the RT target is above maxpart_reject/minpart_reject or >0 but below maxpart_reject_min.

name: Pre-close period adjust
description: Moves the pre-close period: the new period runs from preCloseEnd - a seconds to preCloseEnd - b seconds (order-specific copy of market hours). Optional 3rd field preclose_adj_strict>0 changes ExecutionCustomizer close handling (same branch as moc_submission_no_wait). '0,0' disables.

example.explanation: Pre-close period starts 35 s before its normal end.

interactions.title: JP defaults 253=25/35
interactions.explanation: Rules set 253=25 for NINJA/ICENINJA in JP (unconditional, overrides client) and 253=35 for other non-schedule algos in JP when unset (not JT).

name: Pre-open period adjust
description: Moves the pre-open period on an order-specific market-hours copy: from preOpenEnd - a s to max(preOpenBegin, preOpenEnd - b s). '0,0' disables.

name: PM pre-open period adjust
description: Same as 254 for the afternoon pre-open period; ignored for markets without a PM open.

name: True min-size threshold
description: Threshold (ratio) used by adjustMinSize to reduce min execution size near the end of the order: values <1 become 0. When >0.99 the last slice ignores min fill. Used by WorkOrder, Concert, LC and Take workers.

name: Min-exec only on cancellable venues
description: When >0 (and the order has a min exec size/value), work orders with a min-exec size are not created on exchanges where minExecCxl()==0.
default: AlgoConfig min_exec_cxl_only (0) when a min exec size/value is set

name: Continuous session end adjust
description: Shortens continuous trading for this order: continuousEnd is rolled back by the given duration (suffix s/m/h, plain number = seconds). Applies to both normal and PM market-hours copies.

example.explanation: Stop continuous trading 2 minutes before the normal end.

interactions.title: Setting 258 removes close participation
interactions.explanation: Rule L495 sets 15=0 whenever 258 is present, so the order will not go into the close.

interactions.title: HK/TB short-sell templates set 258=120
interactions.explanation: Short-sell rules for HKNC and TB VWAP/TMX ending at close set 258=120 with 15=0.

name: Trade on non-primary exchange
description: Trades the order on another listing: the value is looked up in config trade_ex_map to get the exchange suffix; if it differs from the stock's exchange, the symbol is rewritten to <root>.<exch> and the stock is reloaded from the security master.

interactions.title: Unknown trade exchange or stock rejects
interactions.explanation: If the key is not in trade_ex_map the order gets _err_msg 'invalid trade exchange'; if the alternate stock cannot be loaded, 'cannot get stock for trade_ex'. Both are returned by checkForError.

interactions.title: Symbol replaced for the order
interactions.explanation: When trading non-primary the order symbol (latch.symbol) becomes the alternate listing; the original is kept as psymbol.

name: Prorate mode
description: Portfolio prorating: mode[,prorate]. mode>0 forces portfolio level 1. Orders in a portfolio must use the same prorate mode/value as the portfolio (FlexOrderStream compares them). Also read by ExecutionCustomizer and ConcertStrategy (prorate_mode<1 is a condition for must-complete handling); passed to scheduler.

interactions.title: Forces portfolio level
interactions.explanation: A prorate mode >0 sets _portfolio_level=1.

name: Price swing check
description: Large intraday price-swing detection for portfolio orders: mode,trigger1,spread1,trigger2,spread2,... (if an odd trailing trigger, its spread is 999999). Only checked during continuous trading (not lunch), for live orders in a portfolio; mode>=3 changes the action taken.

interactions.title: Only for portfolio orders
interactions.explanation: detectedLargePriceSwing returns false when the order has no portfolio.

name: LINE benchmark
description: Benchmark price for LINE orders. mode[,bps]: 0 strike/arrival, 1 VWAP, 2 dVWAP, 3 TWAP, 4 open, 5 prev close, 6 first fill, 7 fixed price (or give a decimal price directly), 8 cVWAP, 9 filtered VWAP, 10 effective VWAP. bps shifts the bench by side*bps.

example.explanation: Benchmark = interval VWAP moved 5 bps in the side direction.

interactions.title: 263=11 is rewritten by rule
interactions.explanation: Rule L351 replaces 263=11 by 0 if the stock opened else 5 (prev close). Rule L206 sets 263=0 for MFSIS.

name: Display size mode
description: Display (shown) size formula used when inviting liquidity: mode,base,delta. Mode 1: pct = base*exp(delta*aggression); mode 2: base + delta*aggression. Unset/zero fields fall back to AlgoConfig.

name: Ninja post
description: When >0, NINJA (and shadow-ninja for would candidates) orders also post passively; read by ConcertStrategy for algotype NINJA / likeShadowNinja.

name: Modify as cancel/new
description: Controls how amends are handled. When the order's modCxlNew is on, a replace is treated as cancel-old/new-order: live child orders are not transferred to the new order, the old order is not put into CLOSE_REPLACE, and the amend waits during no-cancel lockout periods.

interactions.title: Flipped by rule file (conflict C-13)
interactions.explanation: L203 sets 266=2 for ICEDMA/SDMA/DLP, L204 for USEDLP=1, L249 resets to 0 for orders starting at/after close, L524 sets 2 again when tag 383 is present.

name: Broker ranking mode
description: Broker-ranking (market update) mode used by WombatQuoteStream for this order.

name: Participation monitor margin
description: Tolerance (percent) above the max participation rate before the participation monitor intervenes: margin = 1 + max(0.5%, value/100). Value 0 makes the participation limit strict (strictPartLevelLimit=1).

interactions.title: Index trackers forced strict
interactions.explanation: Rule L201 sets 268=0 when indexTrackerAdaptionMode>0 (index tracker adaption also makes strictPartLevelLimit 1 in code).

name: Order duration (minutes)
description: Order duration in minutes (stored as ms); used in OrderMarketStat fair-limit / timing calculations (fair_limit_mdt * duration).

interactions.title: Used in T.Rowe compound leg
interactions.explanation: COMPOUND templates set 269=5 on the VWAP leg.

name: Allow leaving orders over lunch
description: 1 = keep orders on the market during the lunch break (no halt, goal sizes not zeroed); 0 = never; unset = algorithm default (Algorithm.allowLunchBreakLeave).

interactions.title: Asia markets default 270=1
interactions.explanation: Rule L275 sets 270=1 for C1/C2/CH/CN/HK/JP/IJ/TB/PM/MK/SP when unset.

name: Send odd-lot mode
description: Odd-lot handling: >0 allows routing odd lots to the exchange's odd-lot venue; >1 also enables extra odd-lot handling in ABSStrategy and keeps odd-lot aggression orders.

name: Preload mode
description: Integer; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key preload_mode).

name: Finish leftover
description: Finishes small residuals: when open shares fall below a threshold the order completes. mode[,threshold]: modes 1-4 threshold is in local-currency thousands converted to shares by last price; 5-8 threshold is a fraction of order size; modes <3 (1-4) / <7 (5-8) take max with preferred min size. Even modes ignore the max participation cap. For OTD/VWAP/THX only applied near end time.

allowedValues.meaning: Fraction of size, respect max rate
Fraction of size, ignore max rate

name: Dark chase price mode
description: After a dark fill, chase the dark price: mode,nv,tmin,tmax. Mode 1 last fill price, 2 work-order price, 3 average fill price. Within tmin (x ref min duration) the chase price is set; up to tmax it is set only if market volume since the fill <= nv x chased makes.

interactions.title: Default 274=1,275=1 for schedule algos
interactions.explanation: Rule L187 sets 274=1 and 275=1 for VWAP/SHADOW/PART/LINE/SHADOWMIN/IIS/CASH when dark_mid_price_mode=0 (unconditional, overrides client values).

name: Dark chase ping mode
description: mode[,duration]: when >0 and priority is CHASELIQUIDITY, LCWorker builds ping allocations (pingAlloc) with the given ping duration.

interactions.title: Set by rule L187
interactions.explanation: Rule L187 sets 275=1 for schedule algos when dark_mid_price_mode=0.

name: MOO PM rate types
description: Rate type(s) for the afternoon (PM) opening auction: rate[,max[,min]]. 4 = same as morning MOO type. 11 = special worker handling (partRate set on PM open orders, kills orders with other rate). Returns 0 when the stock has no PM open. With 279=0 and the stock not yet PM-opened, the relay algorithm becomes SMART_OPEN.
default: -1 (none); max type defaults to 5 if 277 adv pct given

interactions.title: PM open makes relay SMART_OPEN
interactions.explanation: If moo_pm_rate_type>0, stop_after_moo_pm (279)=0 and the stock has not opened PM, setSmartOpenRelay switches an invalid relay algorithm to SMART_OPEN.

interactions.title: No PM open market
interactions.explanation: All moo_pm_*_rate_type accessors return 0 when the stock has no PM open.

name: MOO PM rates
description: rate[,adv_pct[,min_rate]] for the PM opening auction. adv_pct caps PM open size at % of ADV; min_rate is also used as % of order size. With rate type 4 the morning MOO values are used. Divided across split sub-orders.

name: IMBO PM rate
description: Participation rate (percent) against the PM-open imbalance; used when 276 rate type is 1..9.

interactions.title: Needs PM rate type
interactions.explanation: Only applied when moo_pm_rate_type is between 1 and 9.

name: Stop after MOO PM
description: When >0 the order stops after the PM opening auction; also prevents the SMART_OPEN relay switch.

name: IMBO PM rate type
description: Parsed into _imbo_pm_rate_type but the accessor imbo_pm_rate_type() returns the morning _imbo_rate_type field, so this tag has no effect (bug).

interactions.title: Value ignored (accessor bug)
interactions.explanation: imbo_pm_rate_type() returns _imbo_rate_type, not _imbo_pm_rate_type; the PM imbalance rate type follows the morning setting.

name: Moving-average mode
description: mode[,bps] with mode 0..6; forwarded to the scheduler (mavg_mode, mavg_bps).

interactions.title: Mode outside 0..6 rejects
interactions.explanation: Sets _err_msg 'Invalid MAVG_MODE must be in range [0,6]'.

name: No-history auction handling
description: moo[,moc[,moopm]] flags controlling what happens when an auction-participating order has no auction volume history. 0 = reset doOpen/doClose/doPMOpen to 0 (with AUCTIONWARN alert); other values keep participation (still alerting); the value is also passed to openingVolume/closingVolume and values <2 change config handling.

example.explanation: Keep open and close participation even without auction volume history.

interactions.title: 0 drops auction participation without history
interactions.explanation: With moc_nohist=0 and no closing volume history, doClose is reset to 0 (alert 'no close volume data'); same for open/PM open.

name: MOO base price source
description: Base price for open-auction limit computation: 2/3 used by AuctionWorker when no candidate limit; 4 pre-open VWAP, 5 last price before open, 6 decayed pre-open price (only when last-price trade count exceeds threshold; fields 2/3 = trade-count threshold and order delay seconds); 11 = IPO price for IPO stocks. Default prev close.
default: 0 (prev close); thresholds from AlgoConfig last_price_trdcnt_threshold / last_price_order_delay

interactions.title: KS IPO orders get 283=11
interactions.explanation: Rules L530/L531 set 283=11 (IPO price) with LOR for KS IPOs.

name: Inherit old would/grab percentage
description: would[,grab]: on amend/replace, keep the would (and grab) percentage of the old order (2 = alternative would handling). If only one field is given, grab follows would. Copied to sub-orders.

interactions.title: COMPOUND resets 284=1 to 0
interactions.explanation: Rule L521 sets 284=0 for COMPOUND orders that carry 284=1 (after templates L501/L502 set it).

name: Ninja take mode
description: mode[,pct]: for NINJA orders with a limit price, adjusts take sizes; mode>1 caps take at pct% of order size (default 100).

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Relative VWAP start/end
description: offset_min[,vwap_pct[,estimate_mode[,estimate_once[,moc_max_part_rate]]]] for relative VWAP/TMX: start time is derived from end time minus offset minutes using profile volume; vwap_pct and moc_max_part_rate (% of theoretical close volume) size the close portion. offset>0 or pct>0 prevents conversion to the OPE scheduler algorithm.

interactions.title: Blocks OPE-scheduler conversion
interactions.explanation: Small orders of client algos using the OPE scheduler are converted to OPE<algo>, but only when rvwapStartEndOffset()<=0 and rvwapStartEndVWAPpct()<=0.

interactions.title: RVWAPRELATIVE/RTMXRELATIVE templates
interactions.explanation: Rules L583/L584/L628 build 287 from maxPartLevel*0.75 and moc_rate for clients using caiid RVWAPRELATIVE/RTMXRELATIVE.

name: I-Would include auctions
description: open[,close[,openpm[,ia]]] flags (default 1). Only the open flag is used: 0 skips the I-Would price-risk check before the open (when risk mode <11). The other flags are parsed but not read in this tree.

interactions.title: 289=6 rewritten with 288=0
interactions.explanation: Rules L193/L194 replace 289=6 by 288=0^289=2 (non-AU) or 289=3 (AU).

name: I-Would price risk check
description: mode[,strike[,lit_bps[,dark_bps]]]: validates absolute I-Would (tag 10) and would-dark (207) prices against a strike price (quote last price by strike mode, or prev close before open). If the would price is more than lit_bps/dark_bps through the strike the order/replace is rejected (INVALIDWOULD). Modes 2-5 default the strike mode to NEAR/MID/CROSS/LAST and the bps to ~0. Mode 0 disables.

interactions.title: I-Would too far from market rejects
interactions.explanation: INVALIDWOULD: 'iwould price more than N bps away' when an absolute would price is beyond the configured range from the strike price.

name: Grab price risk check
description: mode[,strike[,range_bps]]: checks the grab threshold price against the strike (quote by strike mode, or prev close); if beyond range bps and mode>=2 (or the grab price is absolute) the order is rejected with INVALIDGRAB.

interactions.title: Grab price too far rejects
interactions.explanation: rejectOrder(INVALIDGRAB) when the grab threshold is more than range bps from the strike and risk mode >=2 or the grab price is absolute.

name: Reject open order without venue
description: Parsed with an accessor defaulting to AlgoConfig reject_doopen_novenue (0), but reject_doopen_novenue() is not called anywhere in this tree; no observable effect.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Index tracker strike price modes
description: sprice_mode[,strike_price_mode] (Strike.MODE letters): which quote price index-tracker logic uses for the stock price and for the benchmark strike.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

interactions.title: Set by MFSIS template
interactions.explanation: Rule L206 sets 294=1 for MFSIS LINE orders (consumed by the scheduler).

name: Band mode
description: m or m,width[-max],bench,bps band parameters forwarded to the scheduler; band_mode 4-5 changes OrderHolder handling and IoIWorker includes leaves when >3.

interactions.title: Wrong field count throws
interactions.explanation: Values with 2 or 3 fields throw 'Tag 295 has to be 295=m or 295=m,pct,t,bps' while parsing.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

interactions.title: VWAP with 296 gets 23=0
interactions.explanation: Rule L126 sets 23=0 for VWAP orders carrying 296.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Portfolio PM-tracker threshold unit
description: Unit for the portfolio PM tracker thresholds: 0 = bps, 1 = weighted spread. Passed to PortfolioPMTracker.

name: RegSHO complete buffer
description: buffer_s[,always[,uptick]] for short sells under short-sale restriction: when RegSHO triggers and buffer>0 (and always>0, or must-complete, or a scheduled algo) the end time is moved to continuousEnd - buffer seconds and doClose is reset to 0. A 3rd field enables uptick-only (but the parser reads it from field 2).
default: OEO config regsho_complete_buffer / regsho_complete_buffer_always per exchange

interactions.title: RegSHO completion drops the close
interactions.explanation: With buffer>0 at RegSHO trigger, doClose is set to 0 and end time pulled before continuous end.

interactions.title: Uptick field parsed from wrong position
interactions.explanation: _regsho_complete_apply_uptick_limit is set from a[1] (the 'always' field) when 3 fields are given, then applied via set_uptick_only.

interactions.title: Short-sell rules by market (C-06/C-07)
interactions.explanation: HK/JP/KS/MK/TB short-sell rules set 302 (600/900/300/15,1); in MK and KS the first rule makes later RSHO rules unreachable.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Optimizer mode
description: Integer; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key opti_mode).

name: Check off-tick
description: Per-order override of the off-tick price check; default from OEO config check_offtick(stock). The accessor is not called elsewhere in this tree.

name: Prefer smart posts
description: mode[,weight]: prefer posting via smart (dual-listing) routes, weight default 1.5. When unset, OEO config prefer_smart_posts(stock) is used (values >100 minus 100; otherwise 0 when the stock has no dual listing). Accessors are not called elsewhere in this tree.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Scheduler mode / tilt
description: mode,reverse_part,vwap_tilt[,min_duration] (at least 3 fields) forwarded to the scheduler (mode, reverse_part, vwap_tilt, min_duration). Used by the GS front/back-loaded VWAP templates (mode 1 front, 2 back).

interactions.title: Fewer than 3 fields throws
interactions.explanation: Parser throws 'Tag 310 has to have at least 3 fields'.

interactions.title: Sets RNT=0
interactions.explanation: Rule L353 sets RNT=0 whenever 310 is present.

name: Index tracker market view
description: Market view for index-tracker orders: 1 neutral (0), 2 favourable (+1), 3 unfavourable (-1); otherwise derived from index_tracker_adaption. Sent to the scheduler as 'favorable'.

name: Send residual after close (TAL)
description: Sends the residual into the after-close (trade-at-last) session. mode[,x]: 2 or >=4 also for market orders; 3 = HK short-sell-to-close at static reference price (also enforces RegSHO handling for non-ETF short sells); 5,delay; 6/7,bench_mode[,price_offset[,delay]]; 13 = I-Would to TAL; other modes field2 = max shares after close. Many close/EOD paths test >0.

interactions.title: 312=3 forces RegSHO for HK short sells
interactions.explanation: regSHO() returns true for short sells when 312=3 and the stock is not ETF/ETP (enforceRegSHO>0).

interactions.title: SEA SDMA default 312=2, then 232=0
interactions.explanation: Rule L290 sets 312=2 for SDMA in SP/IJ/MK/PM/AU, which makes L291 set 232=0 for orders starting before MOC. HK short-sell rules L280/L281 set 312=3.

name: Take on large quote size
description: threshold[,fraction[,mode]]: threshold is a size with unit suffix S shares, T avg trade size, R round lots, Q/none median quote size, A ADV; '&' takes min, '|' max of several. Takes are only allowed when the inside quote size >= threshold; with mode>0 and fraction>0 the must-make size is raised by fraction x quote size.

example.explanation: Take only when quote size >= 2x median quote; then make up to half the quote.

name: Prev-close mismatch check
description: reject_factor[,warn_bps[,warn_ticks]]: compares original vs current prev close. If the difference exceeds ticks and bps: alert 'StockCloseMismatch' when factor<0.1, or reject (INVALIDCLOSE) when it exceeds factor x the thresholds.

interactions.title: Prev close discrepancy rejects
interactions.explanation: rejectOrder(INVALIDCLOSE) when |prevCloseOrg-prevClose| > factor*ticks*tick and > factor*bps.

interactions.title: ARROWST baskets get 314=20,5,1
interactions.explanation: Rule L303.

name: MOC limit price mode
description: mode[,range[,range4]]: limit price for close-auction orders computed by Statics.auctionLimit(mode, range, quote). Modes 5-9 (10 for portfolios) use a WAP from the quote and add moving-average subscriptions (205/210/215/220); mode 8 falls through and also adds 230 and mode 9 adds none (missing 'case' keyword). With CLO/QCLO TIF and range>0 a path is disabled.

interactions.title: China/JP defaults
interactions.explanation: C1/C2/CH get 315=3,1000 (3,2000 for ChiNext/STAR); JP short sells get 315=2,499 when unset.

name: MOO PM limit price mode
description: mode[,range] limit-price rule for PM open auction orders (Statics.auctionLimit).

name: Trade filter
description: filter1,filter2,...[:mode]: trade filters applied to the order's market statistics (volume counted). mode 1 also uses the filtered OMS for participation regulation and pmid worker.

interactions.title: AU/KS defaults
interactions.explanation: AU gets 317=CP:1 (when 239 also unset); KS with KTF=1 gets 317=NOKT.

name: Synthetic SOR mode
description: Synthetic smart-order-router for India dual listing: >=1 enables the synthetic India router (dual trade); 3 forces work orders to exchange IB, 4 to IS.

name: IOI limit price
description: Limit price for IOI (indication of interest) activity, in I-Would price syntax (M prefix = multi-price).

name: OPE open buffer
description: Seconds after continuous begin after which the OPE treats an unopened stock as opened (stock copy marked opened). Minimum 1 s when ope_open_mode>1.

interactions.title: Market defaults via rules
interactions.explanation: TB 300, KS 180, SDMA in MK/HK/CN/IN/PM/SP 1, others (non-JP) 60, together with 162=10.

name: Reserved for scheduler
description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

name: Allow volatility auction
description: 1 = ignore stock halts (keep trading through volatility auctions); 2 = ignore halts only when the HLTA flag is set. Default per algorithm from OEO config.

name: Dark chase price thresholds
description: agg0,agg1,pas0,pas1,wait thresholds (in spreads, and wait x ref min duration) used by LCWorker to decide whether a dark order's price is far enough from the chase price to be repriced.

interactions.title: Needs dark chase
interactions.explanation: Only relevant when dark chase price mode (274) is active.

name: Low/high would mode
description: Parsed but low_high_would_mode() is never called in this tree; no observable effect.

name: Take spread check
description: mode0[,mode1_min[,avg[,factor%]]]: large-spread check before taking. mode0%10>0 compares against current near price, mode1 against the moving average over N minutes; spread is 'large' if it exceeds max(avg x stock spread, factor x price). <30 blocks takes when spread is large; 10-29 also affects LC/Concert; >=30 only raises a LargeSpread alert.

interactions.title: mode1 default bug
interactions.explanation: take_spread_mode1() writes the config default into _take_spread_mode0 instead of mode1.

name: Portfolio lock wait
description: Seconds to wait for the portfolio lock when issuing portfolio orders.

name: Post chase price
description: mode,agg0,agg1,pas0,pas1,wait: when to reprice a resting post relative to the reference price (distance measured in spreads). Within agg0/pas0 reprice only after wait x ref min duration; beyond agg1 reprice immediately; mode>1 never reprices between agg0 and agg1. Mode <=0 uses the default priceOff logic.

interactions.title: IN and KS short sell defaults
interactions.explanation: IN gets 327=1 when unset; KS RSHO short sells get 327=2,0,10.

name: Order round-lot size override
description: Overrides the stock round-lot size for this order.

interactions.title: STAR board 200 and odd-lot rules
interactions.explanation: China STAR/STGR buys (and SG sells) get 328=200; TT ODDONLY gets 328=1; ODDVWAP China orders smaller than a lot get 328=size.

name: Moving-average relative limit windows
description: t1,t2[,adaption[,window]]: two moving-average windows (subscribed as 11000+t) used for a relative limit price; candidates are held until both averages are available.

name: S0 adjust (close)
description: mode[,residual[,imb]]; mode>0 stops setEUMOCAfterClose from resetting the order for EU after-close MOC (unless 312 enforcement applies). Values also go to the scheduler.

name: Uptick only
description: For short sells: >0 restricts DMA/NDMA/Peg/ABS workers to uptick pricing; >1 also affects TakeWorker.

interactions.title: KS/TB/JP short sells
interactions.explanation: Rules set LORT=1^331=1 for KS/TB short sells and JP short sells under regSHO.

name: Reject on remaining volume ratio
description: ratio[,mode] (mode 0 greater, 1 less than). Parsed but the accessors are never called in this tree; no observable effect.

name: Chain order
description: mode[,expire_min[,refid[,size_jump]]]: chains a new order to a previous one (found by target id or client order id). On cancel the order stays live for expire minutes; refid replaces the client order id; if size change > threshold x remaining, the chain breaks. Chain orders skip relay-algorithm adjustment and ignore the split tag.

interactions.title: Split and relay adjustments disabled
interactions.explanation: split() returns empty and adjustRelayAlgorithm returns early when chain mode>0.

name: Index tracker FX mode
description: mode[,ccy|pair]: converts index-tracker reference strikes by an FX rate; field2 = 3-letter currency or currency pair.

interactions.title: Invalid currency rejects
interactions.explanation: Unknown 3-letter currency sets _err_msg 'index tracker currency invalid'.

name: CODA block mode
description: mode[,min_size[,min_size_part]] for CODA block/conditional handling (US only). Effective min sizes are max(given, config coda_min_size_str by market cap). coda_mode() returns 0 outside US or when the order is smaller than the min sizes. Mode 1 changes candidate, IoI and block handling.

interactions.title: Non-US or small orders
interactions.explanation: coda_mode() returns 0 if composite exchange is not US or order size < min sizes.

name: Dark fill rate weight
description: Weight for dark fill rate; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key weight_agg).

name: EOD max mode
description: Integer; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key eod_max_mode).

name: LINE scheduler mode
description: smode[,bound[,padvAcc]] for LINE; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree.

name: Custom imbalance close (IMBC)
description: mode[,pct]: imbcl_mode=1 makes the order eligible for scheduler CUSTOMIMBC (imbalance-close) candidates; other values ignore them. pct goes to the scheduler.

name: Step-up MOC
description: rate[,mode]: extra MOC 'step-up' shares as rate% of the close imbalance (mode 1 = join imbalance only; mode 0 = when in the money vs step-up limit 341). Below a round lot nothing is sent. Divided across split sub-orders (not for moc_rate_type%10==1).

name: Step-up MOC limit
description: Limit price (I-Would price syntax) for step-up MOC orders; falls back to AlgoConfig stepup_moc_limit_str.

interactions.title: Needs step-up MOC
interactions.explanation: Only used when step-up MOC (340) is active.

name: Control venue % of makes
description: [mode,]list of venue/broker/aggression:pct entries limiting the share of fills per venue; parsed by ExchangeMaster into exchange/broker/fixid/aggression maps with shut-off lists. Active when the string is longer than 2 chars.
